sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 350. Success value 100. 3x magic damage (Time).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Applies Miracle.
-Target: all allies. Reduces physical/magic damage taken to 0 (7 times). Effect applied for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies 50% damage reflection for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies the following effect for 120 seconds: Fills Unison gauge by 2 when using an Ability.
-Target: yourself. Applies Protection for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; increases DEF and MDEF by 100%; nullifies status ailments, debuffs, and buff removal effects. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 20000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 20000

[Promise] Nei Okawamura or Ninoyu with the same or higher Cost of the base Monster can be used as fodder.
 *Specific Monsters may also be used. See the Help section for details.
